title: Love it!
text: Love it!. Very nice pot!  It's a perfect size  The pot is heavy weight and non-stick  It's very easy to use for pasta or steaming vegetables.  The pour spout is a plus.  Can't go wrong with Calphalon.  I've even ordered a set of pots like this.  I've only had it for a short period of time.  If any problems develop, I will update my feedback.

product_metadata.title: Calphalon 1932446 Classic Nonstick Stock Pot, 8 quart, Grey
features: Dual-layer nonstick for easy food release, and quick cleanup
Convenient measuring marks, pour spouts & straining lids 3
Stainless steel pasta insert for cooking noodles, vegetables and more
description: The Calphalon Classic Nonstick 8-Quart Multi Pot features dual-layer nonstick for extra-easy food release and cleanup, and is constructed from durable hard-anodized aluminum for fast and even heating. The 8-qt. Multi-Pot is a three-piece set, and includes a large 8-qt. non stick stock pot, stainless steel pasta insert, and glass cover. Use the pasta insert inside the stock pot when cooking pasta, vegetables or potatoes - just lift it up to drain water instead of having to use a separate colander. You can also use the stockpot by itself to cook potatoes, stews or corn on the cob.
